components.Total: The big number on the stat panel
components.Base: What your equipped gear provides (parentheses on the same line)
components.Flats: Bonuses added as raw points (potions, quest rewards)
components.Boosts: Every percentage bonus, added together as decimals (totems, museum, runes, mastery, cookies, friends)
components.Events: True multipliers at the very end (×2 meteor shower, ×1.5 weather events)
